sloka: त्वं हि नारायणः श्रीमांस्त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ।त्वं प्रभुः सर्वदेवानां पुरुषस्त्वं सनातनः ।। ७.७६.२९ ॥
transliteration: tvaṁ hi nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmāṁstvayi sarvaṁ pratiṣṭhitam ।tvaṁ prabhuḥ sarvadevānāṁ puruṣastvaṁ sanātanaḥ ।। 7.76.29 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, you are the glorious Narayana, in whom everything is established; you are the lord of all gods, and you are the eternal being.
